## Key Formulas

- **$n$th Taylor polynomial about $x = x_0$:** $\displaystyle p_n(x) = \sum_{k=0}^{n} \frac{f^{(k)}(x_0)}{k!}(x - x_0)^k$.
- **$n$th Maclaurin polynomial** ($x_0 = 0$): $\displaystyle p_n(x) = \sum_{k=0}^{n} \frac{f^{(k)}(0)}{k!}x^k$.

---

## Type A: First Few Taylor Polynomials About $x_0$

### Problem 1. $f(x) = \ln x$ about $x = 2$

| $k$ | $f^{(k)}(x)$ | $f^{(k)}(2)$ |
|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| 0 | $\ln x$ | $\ln 2$ |
| 1 | $1/x$ | $1/2$ |
| 2 | $-1/x^{2}$ | $-1/4$ |
| 3 | $2/x^{3}$ | $1/4$ |

Substituting into the Taylor formula with $x_0 = 2$:
$$
\begin{aligned}
p_0(x) &= f(2) = \ln 2\\
p_1(x) &= f(2) + f'(2)(x-2) = \ln 2 + \tfrac12(x-2)\\
p_2(x) &= f(2) + f'(2)(x-2) + \frac{f''(2)}{2!}(x-2)^2 = \ln 2 + \tfrac12(x-2) - \tfrac18(x-2)^2\\
p_3(x) &= f(2) + f'(2)(x-2) + \frac{f''(2)}{2!}(x-2)^2 + \frac{f'''(2)}{3!}(x-2)^3\\
&= \ln 2 + \tfrac12(x-2) - \tfrac18(x-2)^2 + \tfrac1{24}(x-2)^3
\end{aligned}
$$

### Problem 2. $f(x) = \sqrt{x}$ about $x = 4$

| $k$ | $f^{(k)}(x)$ | $f^{(k)}(4)$ |
|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| 0 | $x^{1/2}$ | $2$ |
| 1 | $\tfrac12 x^{-1/2}$ | $\tfrac14$ |
| 2 | $-\tfrac14 x^{-3/2}$ | $-\tfrac1{32}$ |
| 3 | $\tfrac38 x^{-5/2}$ | $\tfrac3{256}$ |

$$
\begin{aligned}
p_0(x) &= 2\\
p_1(x) &= 2 + \tfrac14(x-4)\\
p_2(x) &= 2 + \tfrac14(x-4) - \frac{1/32}{2!}(x-4)^2 = 2 + \tfrac14(x-4) - \tfrac1{64}(x-4)^2\\
p_3(x) &= 2 + \tfrac14(x-4) - \tfrac1{64}(x-4)^2 + \frac{3/256}{3!}(x-4)^3 = 2 + \tfrac14(x-4) - \tfrac1{64}(x-4)^2 + \tfrac1{512}(x-4)^3
\end{aligned}
$$

### Problem 3. $f(x) = \cos x$ about $x = \pi/3$

| $k$ | $f^{(k)}(x)$ | $f^{(k)}(\pi/3)$ |
|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| 0 | $\cos x$ | $\tfrac12$ |
| 1 | $-\sin x$ | $-\tfrac{\sqrt3}2$ |
| 2 | $-\cos x$ | $-\tfrac12$ |
| 3 | $\sin x$ | $\tfrac{\sqrt3}2$ |

$$
\begin{aligned}
p_0(x) &= \tfrac12\\
p_1(x) &= \tfrac12 - \tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right)\\
p_2(x) &= \tfrac12 - \tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right) - \frac{1/2}{2!}\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right)^2 = \tfrac12 - \tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right) - \tfrac14\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right)^2\\
p_3(x) &= \tfrac12 - \tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right) - \tfrac14\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right)^2 + \frac{\sqrt3/2}{3!}\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right)^3\\
&= \tfrac12 - \tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right) - \tfrac14\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right)^2 + \tfrac{\sqrt3}{12}\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right)^3
\end{aligned}
$$
